text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right in the middle of an unprecedented 
Feng Shui boom, Copano Rickey received 
countless media interview requests and 
threw herself into spreading the wonders 
of Feng Shui.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Hokko Tarumae conquered the 
dirt GⅠ Teio Sho. At last, she could 
promote her hometown of Tomakomai on a 
massive stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a television appearance one day, 
Copano Rickey realizes that her dream of 
bringing happiness to everyone through 
feng shui has truly come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then what reason is there to race any 
further— Carrying these doubts, she busied 
herself with media appearances.
